title: The generic consistency verifier: every check it makes, removed
note: tools/generic_consistency.py is the framework's successor to the legacy QTA verifier (directive 17): event history, evidence, independent reconstruction, scientific artifacts, model identity. Each check is removed here and tests/test_generic_consistency.py, on a real governed history damaged one way at a time, must notice.

mutations.name: GC1_the_chain_is_not_verified
mutations.rationale: trust a history whose hash chain is broken

mutations.name: GC2_the_store_is_not_re_hashed
mutations.rationale: trust wrong evidence bytes: a tampered object reads as its digest

mutations.name: GC3_cited_digests_are_not_resolved
mutations.rationale: lost evidence cited by an authority record goes unnoticed

mutations.name: GC4_refused_transitions_are_ignored
mutations.rationale: bypass replay admission: a forged transition in the log is not reported

mutations.name: GC5_undecidable_admissions_are_ignored
mutations.rationale: an admission nobody can re-decide passes as decided

mutations.name: GC6_the_live_store_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: the live projection and the independent reader may disagree

mutations.name: GC7_a_store_refusal_is_swallowed
mutations.find:
out["RECONSTRUCTION"].append(f"the live store refuses the history: "
                                     f"{exc}")
mutations.rationale: a history the live store will not load reads as consistent

mutations.name: GC8_documents_are_not_parsed
mutations.rationale: a document that is not a ResultBundle or VerificationResult passes the schema check

mutations.name: GC9_the_subject_is_not_compared
mutations.rationale: a report about another bundle passes

mutations.name: GC10_any_model_is_admitted
mutations.rationale: a model the catalog does not admit passes the identity check

mutations.name: GC11_any_check_is_admitted
mutations.rationale: a check the catalog does not admit passes the identity check

mutations.name: GC12_findings_exit_zero
mutations.find: return FINDING if found else OK
mutations.rationale: the CI step exits 0 with findings printed
